drone.name: Drone
drone.description: Deploy a firing drone for 5 seconds.

helper.name: Subagents
helper.description: Call Linus Torvalds or Uncle Bob to punch every enemy.

both.name: Both directions
both.description: Shoot left and right together for 10 seconds.

wave.name: Shockwave
wave.description: Eliminate normal enemies; leave resistant enemies one hit from defeat.

heal.name: Self-healing
heal.description: Restore 20 energy, up to 60 maximum. Always costs 5 tokens; no free use.

vacuum.name: Vacuum
vacuum.description: Hold FIRE to suck in enemies; release to launch. Release before the fifth enemy: a full tank explodes, costs 6 energy and destroys the vacuum. Lasts 25 seconds; always costs 20 tokens.
